image_description: A close-up shot of a stack of colorful ring binders and folders on a wooden surface. A lime green binder stands upright on the right, featuring a clear plastic pocket with a label. To its left is a horizontal stack of thin, flexible plastic folders in blue, red, yellow, and teal. In the foreground, an orange binder lies flat, also with a label. A maroon folder is partially visible at the bottom left.
